verdict.rationale: Marqeta's MCP server is described as letting agents query only 'a designated set of Marqeta's Core API endpoints,' implying some endpoint-level scoping for agent access, and spend/velocity controls could theoretically constrain an agent-issued card's usage. However, there is no explicit documentation of issuing scoped or least-privilege API credentials (e.g., API keys/OAuth tokens with configurable permission scopes) specifically for an AI agent. Missing for 10: explicit scoped-credential/API-key issuance mechanism, permission granularity documentation, and independent confirmation of least-privilege enforcement for agents.
